title: Universaarl Number Series active editor probe
goal: Find the real editable Startnr./Endnr. cell or editor on U-CUST Number Series Lines before any broader number-series setup assignment.
successCriteria: Screenshot and controls JSON identify the foreground U-CUST Number Series Lines grid, not the background list or FactBox.
Active editor evidence shows which element receives input for Startnr. and Endnr.
Checkbox semantics for Offen and Luecken in Nummern zulassen are captured without changing them, unless a later explicit gate allows it.
If values are typed, U-CUST00001 and U-CUST99999 must be visible after blur/reload before the result can be marked setup-ready.
No setup assignment, master data, draft, preview posting, posting or ledger trace occurs.
knownLearningFromTarget016B: Duplicate Startnr./Endnr. captions exist across the main list, Lines modal and FactBox.
Frame-scoped inventory is required to see BC page controls and checkbox states.
Header-coordinate clicks can focus headers/tooltips instead of editable cells.
Checkbox columns were visible and must not be ignored in future Number Series setup evidence.
nextSafeAction: Run TARGET-016D: use Page Inspection/Personalize or another standard UI route to identify a reliable Number Series Lines editor; do not repeat coordinate typing or selected-cell typing.
blockedBy: Active-editor/selected-cell route did not make both target values visible after typing.
keyLearning: Liste bearbeiten / Edit List can put the Number Series Lines grid into editable row mode.
BC grid selected cells are not enough evidence for a writable editor.
Coordinate/header and selected-cell typing can select labels/tooltips/page text instead of writing values.
Checkbox columns such as Offen and Luecken in Nummern zulassen are visible and must be documented before changing them.
